opening: It has been going on for more than 6 months now.
I feel very sleepy during class and while driving to school at 7 AM.
I can't concentrate during classes or while driving.
I get annoyed or irritated at things more easily.
I drink coffee or energy drinks.
My final exams are coming up soon, and I need to study.
This semester, I've taken on a heavier course load to graduate on schedule.

opening.text: I've been having real trouble falling asleep for over six months now. It's making me feel super sleepy during class and even when I'm driving to school at 7 AM, and I just can't concentrate. I find myself getting irritated at things more easily lately. I've been drinking coffee or energy drinks to keep going, especially since my final exams are coming up soon and I've taken on a heavier course load this semester to graduate on schedule.
